info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Routes-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Route Retrieval API allows users to access and view detailed shipment routing information within the logistics system. It provides critical data regarding the paths taken by shipments, ensuring efficient planning and tracking of logistics operations. This API is particularly useful for logistics managers, dispatchers, and analysts who require visibility into shipment routes for operational insights and decision-making. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their routing strategies and improve overall shipment efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the best shipping route for your shipments, optimizing for factors such as distance, cost, and delivery time. Use this to ensure efficient logistics and timely deliveries.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended to retrieve the optimal shipping route based on the specified parameters. Ensure that all necessary details are included to facilitate an accurate route calculation.

201.description: The shipment route has been successfully created.

ListLogisticsShipmentsRoutesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving shipment route operations. It is expected to be a JSON string.

ListLogisticsShipmentsRoutesResponse_201.title: Shipment Route Response

status.description: Indicates whether the shipment route operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the shipment route operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment route.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the shipment route operation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the shipment route operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsRoutesResponse_201.description: This schema represents the response received from the GET operation for shipment routes.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains information regarding the audit of the shipment route operation.
